info.title: SchemaSure — structured extraction
info.summary: Turn messy text, HTML, or document images into guaranteed schema-valid JSON, or pay nothing. SchemaSure V2 is the primary production API.
info.description:
Pay-per-call APIs that extract strict, JSON-Schema-valid typed JSON from unstructured text, HTML, or document images. Output is guaranteed to validate against the caller-supplied JSON Schema (Ajv, draft 2020-12) or the request returns a typed error and is not charged (charge-only-on-success). Both production services use x402 V2 with USDC on Base mainnet; the image service is always paid and has no V1 or free route. A legacy V1 text endpoint provides limited free evaluation calls. No signup, API keys, or account dashboard — built for autonomous AI agents.

Primary production endpoint: POST /v2/extract ($0.01/call, flat, failed calls free, always paid). Image production endpoint: POST /v2/extract-image ($0.03/image, flat, failed calls free, always paid, V2-only). Legacy POST /extract remains available for limited free evaluation and V1 compatibility.

post.summary: Primary production API: extract schema-valid JSON with x402 V2.
post.description: Always paid from the first call. Send the JSON body, decode the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header, sign the live terms, and retry the identical request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The server verifies first and settles only after producing a successful schema-valid response. Trust the live challenge for the price, asset, payee, and resource rather than hardcoding payment terms.

post.summary: Extract schema-valid JSON from a document image with x402 V2.
post.description: Always paid from the first call, with no V1 or free image route. Send base64-encoded PNG, JPEG, or WebP bytes plus a JSON Schema. Decode the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header, sign the live terms, and retry the identical request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The server verifies first and settles only after producing schema-valid JSON. Image bytes are processed transiently and are not persisted by SchemaSure.
